_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy to config/tendencies.json to override the neutral opponent bid model per manager. build_tool_data.py uses it if present. This is the seam where the (local, not-yet-in-repo) calibration/simulation pipeline drops its output. Keys must match the manager names build_tool_data produces (ESPN owner display names). Omit a manager to leave them neutral.

Some Manager._mult: Per-position aggressiveness vs. projected value. 1.0 = pays exactly worth; >1 = overpays.
Some Manager._conc: Stars-and-scrubs tendency. >72 = boosts bids on elite players, fades mid-tier.
Some Manager._maxbuy: Hard cap on any single bid (dollars).
